title: アニメーション「就活狂想曲」(Recruit Rhapsody) — The Madness of Job Hunting
description: A 7-minute animated short film satirizing the intense Japanese job-hunting (就活) culture. Follows a college student as she conforms to the rigid conventions of Japanese recruitment: black-suit uniformity, group bowing, identical interview answers, and the cultural pressure to fit into corporate molds. Uses visual storytelling and dark comedy to critique the homogenization of Japanese youth in the job market. Famous among educators as a cultural commentary on 就活 pressures.
creator: Maho Yoshida (Tokyo University of the Arts)
